page.layout: One printed page, single column of text in the centre-right; below the text a woodcut ornament (no text); signature mark at the lower right corner. No margin notes.

main_text.p: meas alias vix cassæ nucis æstimo: quique vnus commentariorum aliorum iacturam Theologicis Scholis pensare bona parte possit. Quare & hunc tibi quoque diligentissimè habebis commendatum: inprimis verò postremam istam meam recognitionem, in exilio meo factam, si quid interea humanitus mihi accidat, Typographis sic edendam trades, habitâ ratione ADIVRATIONIS illius, quam novissimæ editioni præfixeram. &c. VALE. Ex Patmo in Lievvna, vbi furente in Palatinatu Marte, & milite Hispano, Bavaroque grassante, exulabam. Anno 1621. ad diem 30. Decemb. Natalitieo
main_text.head: LXXIV.

page.notes: The text is set in italic type. The ornament below the text is a woodcut and was not transcribed. "Natalitieo" is uncertain (printed as Natalimeo); marked as read from the scan. The signature mark "D. SI." is at the lower right. The running head and page number are not printed on this page.
